decisions.statement: The reading is the plant grams of every food entry inside the day's window.
The window the entries are counted over is handed in rather than worked out here.
Grams given as text are read as the number that text spells.
A food entry with no plant grams adds nothing to the total.
A food entry whose grams spell no number adds nothing to the total.
A day with no food entry is a reading of zero rather than no reading.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns grams into a color.

definition: how many grams of whole plants Alan has eaten in a day
